title: Let the Little Fire Sing
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Jeremiah had a tired day,
The people turned away;
He thought he'd hold his words inside
And keep them locked away.

[Chorus]
A little fire inside my bones,
A warm and glowing light;
When something true is in my heart,
I'll sing it out so bright!

[Verse 2]
His word was like a burning fire,
It would not stay inside;
He opened up his mouth and sang,
"O praise the Lord!" he cried.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Scout learned a brand new song at school
And tried to keep it in;
The car door shut, and out it came,
All bubbling with a grin!

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
Put one hand flat upon your chest
And hum a little tune;
Heavenly Father keeps that light
Through all the afternoon.

[Chorus]
mood: Bubbling-over music. A light, quick-stepping pulse under the voice, like a song that has been held in all the way home and spills out the moment the car door shuts. Ukulele strummed softly on the beat, an upright bass walking warmly underneath, a glockenspiel answering the end of each line. It starts held-in and small, each verse lets a little more out, and it ends warm and open in the middle of the afternoon, never loud.
